label: Application and case helper
description: Check whether an application includes what you asked for, or turn case notes into a clear summary.

guidance.input: Paste an application and your checklist, or paste case notes and any rules you want it to use.
guidance.output: An application checklist or case summary showing where each point came from, what is missing and what needs clarification.
guidance.limits: It only reads what you supply. It cannot look up missing documents, change business systems or decide whether to approve something. Requirements and proposal review is in preview.
guidance.delegation: It hands your task to a specialist agent (Application checker or Case notes summarizer), then returns their findings in one reply. It uses both only if you ask for both, and may first ask what you need.

prompts.label: Review an application
prompts.text:
Check this fictional permit application against my checklist. Make a table showing what is included, missing or unclear. Refer to the checklist and document labels so I can check each point. Ask questions that would help fill in the missing details. Missing information is not an automatic failure. Do not approve, deny, score, rank or recommend a permit decision.

CRIT-1: Include a project budget.
CRIT-2: Identify an implementation owner.
CRIT-3: Provide a delivery schedule.
APP-1: The Facilities team is the implementation owner.
APP-2: Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes June 30, 2027.
APP-3: Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes July 31, 2027.

No budget or statement identifying the current schedule is supplied. Point out the disagreement without choosing a date. Do not take any external action.

prompts.label: Summarize case notes
prompts.text:
Read these fictional case notes. Summarize what they say, show where statements disagree or information is missing, and suggest follow-up questions. Refer to the note labels so I can check your answer. Do not choose a date without support or invent rules. Do not decide eligibility or update any system.

CASE-1: Intake completed August 15, 2026; follow-up August 22, 2026.
CASE-2: Intake completed August 17, 2026; follow-up August 22, 2026.
CASE-3: Proof of address remains outstanding. No supporting document is supplied.

No policy text is supplied. Tell me what a person needs to check next.

prompts.label: Compare a proposal (preview)
prompts.text:
Compare this fictional proposal with my checklist. Make a table with one row per requirement. Show what is described, what is missing, and where the documents disagree. Quote or refer to the document labels so I can check each point. Do not treat a brochure claim as a tested product feature. Ask what else is needed; do not choose a vendor or recommend an award.

CRIT-1: Support CSV export of service-request records.
CRIT-2: Retain audit records for seven years.
CRIT-3: Support single sign-on with documented supported protocols.
PROD-1: The sample product exports service-request records as CSV and retains audit records for seven years.
PROD-2: The sample administrator guide says audit records are deleted after thirty days.
PROD-3: The sample brochure says the product is enterprise-ready.

No other documentation or test results are supplied. Do not assume single sign-on is supported. Missing information does not automatically mean a requirement is failed. Do not take any external action.
